notes: Avacon laid the foundation stone on August 16, 2022 for a new network data center at its Salzgitter-Watenstedt operating site. Energy & Management reported a 1,000 sqm energy data center intended for operation in June 2023 with more than 900 TB storage and 120 virtual machines for energy network data. KO Technik lists commissioning support for the Avacon new data center in Salzgitter during 2023-2024.
